# Urban heat islands

City centres tend to be warmer at night (Oke, 1982). Differences of 1-7 C are reported in the cited reviews [2].

## Limitations

Only two reviews were consulted; local station data was not available.

evidence_requirements: Cite every factual claim with a source
goal.objective: Summarize the evidence on urban heat islands for the council briefing
